# awscc_apiportal_product_sharing_policy (Resource)

Resource Type definition for AWS::APIPortal::ProductSharingPolicy. Singleton sub-property of an AWS::APIPortal::Product capturing the resource-based sharing policy attached via RAM.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `policy_document` (String) JSON IAM-style resource-based policy document. Size limit raised to 409,600 chars per RAM's recommended public-policy onboarding guidance.
- `product_id` (String) The identifier of the parent Product. Singleton key for this CFN type.

### Optional

- `tags` (Attributes List) The tags associated with the product sharing policy. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.

<a id="nestedatt--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tags`

Optional:

- `key` (String)
- `value` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_apiportal_product_sharing_policy.example
  identity = {
    product_id = "product_id"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `product_id` (String) The identifier of the parent Product

#### Optional

- `account_id` (String) AWS Account where this resource is managed
- `region` (String) Region where this resource is managed

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_apiportal_product_sharing_policy.example
  id = "product_id"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
$ terraform import awscc_apiportal_product_sharing_policy.example "product_id"
```
